description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) on the x-axis and BLEU score on the y-axis for four different model configurations in simultaneous machine translation. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” spans from approximately 2.5 to 11.0 with major tick marks at 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0, using a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 25 to 33 with major tick marks at intervals of 1.0. Four lines are plotted: “Consistency-CE” (purple circles connected by a dashed line) starts at BLEU ≈ 25.8 at AL=2.5 and rises to BLEU ≈ 31.3 at AL=10.5; “Inconsistency-CE” (purple squares connected by a dashed line) begins at BLEU ≈ 26.0 at AL=2.5 and increases to BLEU ≈ 31.5 at AL=10.5; “Inconsistency-CE-MP” (blue squares connected by a dashed line) starts at BLEU ≈ 26.2 at AL=2.5 and reaches BLEU ≈ 31.8 at AL=10.5; and a fourth line (red stars connected by a solid line, labeled in the legend as “Inconsistency-CE-MP” but visually distinct) begins at BLEU ≈ 28.9 at AL=3.5 and climbs to BLEU ≈ 32.2 at AL=10.5. All lines show a generally increasing trend in BLEU as AL increases, with the red star line consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across the range.
